name: @lacspace/commentguard
description: Comment moderation for English, romanized Nepali and Devanagari — scores spam, abuse, hate, doxxing and link-spam and returns an allow / review / flag / hide action, with PII detection (Nepali phone, email, URLs/shorteners) and FAQ auto-reply suggestions. Deterministic rules + small, extendable lexicons; a borderline flag marks gray-zone comments for an optional AI second opinion. Exposes a describe() command schema. Zero dependencies.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
